designationHistory.name: Swan Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Swan Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7563 on February 27, 1937, and it was renamed Swan Lake National Wildlife Refuge in 1940.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS Realty establishment record; fws.gov history) and Pass B (order text; National Archives table) agree. Renamed Swan Lake National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.

sources.name: National Archives, Executive Orders Disposition Tables, 1937 (2 FR 537)
